title: chore(tests): recommend testing-library

This will serve as a marker when editing tests that it might be time to refactor from enzyme to testing-library.

Reasons for this are:

- less buggy (enzyme for example doesn't distinguish between className passed to a component and a dom element)
- doesn't need hacks to work with preact
